evidence.observation: Monotonic pressure rise through growth: 2.979 → 3.038 → 3.097 → 3.177 → 3.249 Torr while Ar setpoint/flow held at 100 sccm, versus flat ~2.92-2.95 Torr during ramp
MFC steady at ~100 sccm, so the pressure rise is not driven by flow
Temperature at setpoint 750 °C with stable heater power; thermal control normal
Sensor not installed — atmosphere/air-ingress cannot be verified as the growth stage requires

args.missing_evidence: An exhaust O2 reading (or leak-up test with Ar off / pump-valve response to an Ar step) to distinguish an air leak from a downstream exhaust restriction; O2 sensor is not installed, so a deliberate flow-step or isolation test is needed.
